hook: Track your stock without relying on manual spreadsheets.
target_audience: Shop owners who track their own inventory - convenience stores, small retail, home-based sellers.
problem: Still counting stock by hand or guessing what's left on the shelf?
solution: Optional per-product stock tracking. Stock decrements automatically on every sale and can be corrected/restocked from Settings -> Inventory.
